svg.title: CAD clear-opening centroid and previous SDK aim point
svg.desc: Top view of the main opening cutout at the hive front rim plane. Blue marks the area centroid measured from the exact CAD boundary; orange marks the previous SDK-defined aim point.

g.text: Outline: main clear-opening boundary in the front rim plane, viewed from above.
The area centroid is not the bounding-box center or a measured ball trajectory target.
